page.notes: The blue stain covers the middle of the left column, so those lines are partly illegible. The ends of "contemptus" and "82" are also uncertain: the printed "8z" was read as 82. The entry "sororum" is printed with a long s that looks like f; it has been read as a plain s. No page number is printed on this page.
